create_mask_decoder: create a MaskDecoder module that predicts segmentation masks from image and prompt embeddings using a transformer architecture
build_mlp_predictor: build a multi-layer perceptron module with configurable layers, ReLU activations, and optional sigmoid output
run_mask_prediction: run mask prediction from image embeddings and sparse prompt embeddings using the MaskDecoder forward method
test_dynamic_multimask: test dynamic multimask selection via stability scores to fall back to best multimask output when single mask stability is low
review_mask_decoder_forward: review the MaskDecoder forward method that selects output masks based on multimask output mode and stability thresholds
